extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the add-ons manager.

extensionDescription.message: Kopiert die aktuell angezeigte E-Mail (Text oder HTML) als Markdown ins Clipboard.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the add-ons manager.

menuItemTitle.description: Context menu entry in the message list.

headerSubject.description: Label for the subject line in the generated Markdown header.

headerFrom.description: Label for the sender in the generated Markdown header.

headerTo.description: Label for the recipients in the generated Markdown header.

headerDate.description: Label for the date in the generated Markdown header.

noTextContent.description: Placeholder body when a message has neither HTML nor plain text content.

headerFolder.description: Label for the source folder reference in the generated Markdown header.

headerMessageId.description: Label for the RFC 5322 Message-ID in the generated Markdown header.

imageLabel.description: Prefix marking an image placeholder in the converted body.

imageNoDescription.description: Fallback text for an image that has neither alt text nor a derivable file name.

imageEmbedded.description: Marks an image that was inlined as a data: URI instead of being linked.

attachmentsHeading.description: Heading of the attachment list appended below the mail body.

attachmentInline.description: Marks an attachment that is referenced from the body as an inline image.

headerDeliveredTo.description: Label for the delivering mailbox/host in the generated Markdown header.
